title: Signature Wisdom Wall
concept: A wall where elder patients share life wisdom — recorded, transcribed, displayed. A lifetime of learning, honored. Concept by Manon.
improvement_over_conventional: Improves on anonymous care with celebrated elder wisdom.
equipment: Low hospital beds and floor mats
patient_flow: Older patients enter via ED, clinic, or post-surgical referral; comprehensive assessment covers medical, functional, cognitive, and social domains. ACE units provide elder-friendly inpatient care preventing decline. Discharge planning is meticulous — medications simplified, home safety checked, caregivers trained, follow-up secured — because transitions are where elders get hurt.
code_demo:
# Signature Wisdom Wall — Signature design prototype
def morse_fall_scale(history_fall, secondary_dx, ambulatory_aid, iv, gait, mental):
    """Morse Fall Scale: 0-24 low, 25-50 moderate, >50 high risk."""
    total = history_fall + secondary_dx + ambulatory_aid + iv + gait + mental
    band = "low" if total <= 24 else "moderate" if total <= 50 else "high"
    return f"Morse {total} -> {band} fall risk"
print(morse_fall_scale(25, 15, 15, 20, 10, 0))
teaching: Simple: the core idea in plain words — what it is and why it matters.
